principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions).

WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

foundations: Tokens: DTCG 2025.10, 56 tokens in T1/T2/T3 tiers (prefix --ui-)
patterns: Multi-step flows keep back/cancel available and preserve entered data.
Active filters/selections are always visible with a single clear-all control.
Spacing hierarchy: semantic.space.inline < semantic.space.stack < semantic.space.panel.
Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
Numeric data uses tabular numerals and right alignment.
content_rules: Derived values show how they were derived (source + formula) where users act on them.
state_rules: Async actions render LOADING then SUCCESS or ERROR; never a silent completion.
Draft state persists across navigation; STALE drafts are labeled with their age.
motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables non-essential animation; state changes remain perceivable statically.
accessibility_rules: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): Text meets 4.5:1 (AA); body text targets 7:1 (AAA) where tokens allow.
Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): Under forced-colors: active, states keep icon + text channels and borders use system colors.
WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions).
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow: Content reflows at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (data tables excepted with scroll containers).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

foundations: Tokens: DTCG 2025.10, 54 tokens in T1/T2/T3 tiers (prefix --ui-)
patterns: Multi-step flows keep back/cancel available and preserve entered data.
Active filters/selections are always visible with a single clear-all control.
Spacing hierarchy: semantic.space.inline < semantic.space.stack < semantic.space.panel.
Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
Numeric data uses tabular numerals and right alignment.
content_rules: Derived values show how they were derived (source + formula) where users act on them.
state_rules: Async actions render LOADING then SUCCESS or ERROR; never a silent completion.
Draft state persists across navigation; STALE drafts are labeled with their age.
motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables non-essential animation; state changes remain perceivable statically.
accessibility_rules: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): Text meets 4.5:1 (AA); body text targets 7:1 (AAA) where tokens allow.
Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): Under forced-colors: active, states keep icon + text channels and borders use system colors.
WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions).
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow: Content reflows at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (data tables excepted with scroll containers).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

foundations: Tokens: DTCG 2025.10, 53 tokens in T1/T2/T3 tiers (prefix --ui-)
patterns: Multi-step flows keep back/cancel available and preserve entered data.
Active filters/selections are always visible with a single clear-all control.
Spacing hierarchy: semantic.space.inline < semantic.space.stack < semantic.space.panel.
Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
Numeric data uses tabular numerals and right alignment.
content_rules: Derived values show how they were derived (source + formula) where users act on them.
state_rules: Async actions render LOADING then SUCCESS or ERROR; never a silent completion.
Draft state persists across navigation; STALE drafts are labeled with their age.
motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables non-essential animation; state changes remain perceivable statically.
accessibility_rules: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): Text meets 4.5:1 (AA); body text targets 7:1 (AAA) where tokens allow.
Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): Under forced-colors: active, states keep icon + text channels and borders use system colors.
WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions).
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow: Content reflows at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (data tables excepted with scroll containers).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

principles_applied.name: Bidirectional layout
principles_applied.user_problem: Mirrored locales break physical-direction layouts.
principles_applied.application: Use logical properties (inline-start/end) everywhere; icons with direction mirror.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reading order matches visual order in both directions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Transforms are expressed in logical axes.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: No left/right CSS in components.

principles_applied.name: Truthful AI provenance
principles_applied.user_problem: Users over-trust or mis-attribute machine output.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Truthful progress
principles_applied.user_problem: Fake progress bars and invented ETAs destroy trust.
principles_applied.application: Show determinate progress only when the backend reports it; otherwise indeterminate + elapsed time.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less reassuring than a fabricated percentage.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Progress uses role=progressbar with aria-valuenow only when determinate.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Progress stays in the primary region when layouts stack.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Progress components accept `determinate: false` without a value.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Regions carry priority + emphasis metadata.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

design_genome.geometry: tight grid, tabular alignment, small radius
design_genome.typography: system sans for UI, monospace for data; scale by role not by page
design_genome.color: neutral data surfaces; status colors always paired with icon + text
design_genome.material: bordered panels on a single surface level
design_genome.signature: one product-specific element derived from Acme's thesis (not generic decoration)

foundations: Tokens: DTCG 2025.10, 56 tokens in T1/T2/T3 tiers (prefix --ui-)
patterns: Multi-step flows keep back/cancel available and preserve entered data.
Active filters/selections are always visible with a single clear-all control.
Spacing hierarchy: semantic.space.inline < semantic.space.stack < semantic.space.panel.
Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
Numeric data uses tabular numerals and right alignment.
content_rules: Derived values show how they were derived (source + formula) where users act on them.
state_rules: Async actions render LOADING then SUCCESS or ERROR; never a silent completion.
Draft state persists across navigation; STALE drafts are labeled with their age.
motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables non-essential animation; state changes remain perceivable statically.
accessibility_rules: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): Text meets 4.5:1 (AA); body text targets 7:1 (AAA) where tokens allow.
Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): Under forced-colors: active, states keep icon + text channels and borders use system colors.
WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions).
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow: Content reflows at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (data tables excepted with scroll containers).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Search, filter, sort
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot narrow large collections.
principles_applied.application: Search is debounced, results count is announced, empty results suggest recovery.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Result counts announced via live region.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filters move into a DRAWER on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Query state is URL-backed.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Data components expose SKELETON/EMPTY/ERROR/STALE.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Each region declares its transform.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Focus ring uses semantic.color.focus-ring.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

principles_applied.name: Structured density for expert users
principles_applied.user_problem: Experts are slowed by consumer-grade whitespace.
principles_applied.application: Denser rows with strict alignment and tabular numerals; density never drops below target sizes.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Density respects the 24px minimum target size.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Density relaxes on touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Density is a token scale, not ad hoc spacing.

principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: User control and freedom
principles_applied.user_problem: Users get trapped in flows they cannot leave or undo.
principles_applied.application: Every step offers back/cancel without data loss; drafts persist.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Draft persistence needs storage and conflict handling.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Focus returns to a logical element after cancel.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Back/cancel stay reachable in the collapsed layout.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Flow state is serializable so drafts survive navigation.

principles_applied.name: Recognition over recall
principles_applied.user_problem: Users must remember identifiers, filters, or prior choices.
principles_applied.application: Show current filters, selections, and recent items in place.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Active filters are exposed as a labeled list, not color alone.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Filter chips WRAP, then collapse into a count + drawer on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Filter state lives in the URL for shareability and back-button support.

principles_applied.name: Proximity and common region
principles_applied.user_problem: Related controls read as unrelated noise.
principles_applied.application: Group related fields/metrics in labeled regions; spacing inside groups is tighter than between groups.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Groups use fieldset/legend or region landmarks with names.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Groups STACK as units; they never split across columns.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Spacing uses semantic tokens (inline < stack < panel).

principles_applied.name: Progressive disclosure
principles_applied.user_problem: Everything-at-once screens overload working memory.
principles_applied.application: Primary fields and metrics first; advanced options behind an explicit disclosure.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Disclosures use aria-expanded and keep focus in place.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Secondary panels COLLAPSE before primary content shrinks.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Disclosure components expose EXPANDED state.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Meets WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Buttons enforce a min-block-size token.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Tesler's law — own the irreducible complexity
principles_applied.user_problem: Pushing complexity onto users produces errors and abandonment.
principles_applied.application: The system pre-fills, validates, and explains; users confirm rather than compute.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Moves logic into the backend contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Explanations are text, not tooltips-only.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Explanations remain inline on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Backend contracts return derived values with provenance.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget

principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.

composition: UI/UX compiler: direction — Editorial Warmth: Content-led pages with generous type scale and sourced imagery doing the persuading.
UI/UX compiler: genome hierarchy — large display type leading a single narrative column; density HIGH

UI/UX compiler: Screen 'Landing page' (P0): Convert a qualified visitor. Regions in priority order: hero [P0, stack, stack when narrow]; features [P1, grid, stack when narrow]; final-cta [P1, stack, full_width when narrow]; header-nav [P1, cluster, menu when narrow]; evidence [P2, stack, stack when narrow]; footer [P3, cluster, stack when narrow]. Components: SiteHeader, HeroSection, PrimaryCTA, FeatureList, EvidenceBlock, SiteFooter. Use only --ui-semantic-* and --ui-component-* tokens. Every state keeps a non-color channel. Do not invent testimonials, logos, metrics, or AI confidence.
interaction: UI/UX compiler: Active filters/selections are always visible with a single clear-all control.
UI/UX compiler: Spacing hierarchy: semantic.space.inline < semantic.space.stack < semantic.space.panel.
UI/UX compiler: Exactly one primary action per view; secondary actions use the subordinate variant.
UI/UX compiler: Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
UI/UX compiler: Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
UI/UX compiler: Numeric data uses tabular numerals and right alignment.
UI/UX compiler: Replace generic decoration (gradients, glows, floating blobs) with one brand-derived signature element.
UI/UX compiler: SiteHeader activate via POINTER, TOUCH, SCREEN_READER, KEYBOARD; feedback: PRESSED within one frame; outcome via state change and status text
UI/UX compiler: PrimaryCTA activate via POINTER, TOUCH, SCREEN_READER, KEYBOARD; feedback: PRESSED within one frame; outcome via state change and status text

UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value — Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state. [REQUIRES_ASSISTIVE_TECH]
UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast — Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1. [VERIFIED_STATIC]
UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text — Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function. [REQUIRES_HUMAN_EVALUATION]
UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color — Status and state are never conveyed by color alone. [REQUIRES_HUMAN_EVALUATION]
UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 Info and Relationships — Visual groups are programmatic groups (fieldset/legend, labeled regions). [REQUIRES_ASSISTIVE_TECH]

UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels — Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy. [REQUIRES_HUMAN_EVALUATION]
UI/UX compiler: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) — Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44. [REQUIRES_HUMAN_EVALUATION]
